page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The x86_64 architecture supports hardware-level multithreading with 2 threads per core, backed by 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core.

The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network performance is defined by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. In terms of instruction set extensions, the processor supports Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX), AES, Vector AES (VAES), SHA extensions (SHA_NI), and bit manipulation instructions like BMI2, ADX, and FMA. However, it lacks AVX-512 and AMX capabilities.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and decompression tasks fall within the average tier. The system delivers balanced performance for database operations and static web serving. Given its compute-heavy 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without massive memory footprints, such as web serving, software compilation, and general-purpose compute tasks.
